_how_to_add: Settings for the Videos section of the Gallery (assets/videos.js) and the videos on My journey. "videos": the videos listed first, in this order; the first is in the large player when the page opens. A YouTube video needs "youtube": its id (the part after watch?v=, youtu.be/ or embed/), a clip kept on the site needs "src" (an MP4 in assets/media/) and "poster"; each has a title, and may have kind, meta, date (YYYY-MM) and length (m:ss). After them come the channel's other videos, from data/youtube.json, which agent/fetch_youtube.py rewrites every week (see docs/MAINTAINING.md, Videos); until it exists, the channel and the "playlists" here (id, title, count) follow, each played by YouTube's own player. "hide": YouTube video or playlist ids to leave out. "journey": videos or playlists to show on My journey, each at a stop named by its short name as on the timeline ("Amirkabir"), or year and short name when a name repeats ("2023 NASA"); after changing it, run python scripts/build_journey.py.
